notes: *the time* is taken as the ASV's expansion of the nominalized infinitive `הָחֵל` rather than as part of the preposition's rendering; the competing reading gives `מִן` the whole *from the time* as a compound temporal conjunction.
*to put* is `added`: the Hebrew coordinates the sickle directly with the infinitive of beginning, so no morpheme is there to carry a second lexical verb (rule 20).
`קָמָה` → *standing grain* heads on *standing* under rule 31; heading on *grain* was the competing reading.
